MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The HDMI cable was the closest match because, like my DVI cable, it serves a practical display connection need, though I would skip it without a current need for HDMI."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Smart speakers and streaming devices do not help with the computer connections and ports I have bought accessories for.",
    "Buying a tablet mount does not mean I need a replacement tablet, and buying a headset does not mean I want a portable speaker.",
    "The memory card and camera address needs I have not expressed through my purchases."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "The recommendations seem to treat an interest in computer accessories as an interest in electronics generally.",
    "Several widely popular devices appear despite having little connection to the specific tasks my past purchases served."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases mostly help existing equipment connect or work together, especially through networking adapters, USB ports, and display cables.",
    "The connection type and compatibility matter to me; an HDMI cable is only useful if that is the connection I need.",
    "My purchases are infrequent and solve particular needs, so even a related accessory would not prompt me to act without a reason to use it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my interest in electronics but missed my more specific pattern of buying practical accessories for existing equipment."
}
